result.topic_en: Observation records of oscillation times for determining torsion (with and without loading) and for oscillations of bar A in the observatory, with times, derived values and the logarithmic decrement.

methods.what: Determination of oscillation period by timing successive transits and reducing each by multiples of the period (period 20.78 s) to a common epoch
Logarithmic decrement of the oscillation amplitude
Torsion ratio of the suspension determined from deflections at different torsion-circle settings
Timing oscillations of bar A with period 12.87 s, reduced to common epoch, with chronometer comparison to Shelton clock
